bio: Why not treat yourself to a wonderful Afternoon Tea experience at Park Plaza Cardiff. Indulge in a delicious range of treats at this 4 star deluxe hotel set in the heart of this vibrant city.  Traditional Afternoon Tea is served in the Laguna Restaurant, where guests can relax and while away the afternoon while indulging in the great British ritual of Afternoon Tea. Guests feeling in a decadent mood can choose to take the Hendrick's Gin Afternoon Tea that is only served in their stylish Laguna Bar.  Park Plaza Cardiff offer their own interpretation of a classic Afternoon Tea featuring a selection of sumptuous finger sandwiches, scones and a range of delightful Welsh Cakes. There is also the option to upgrade to add a glass of Champagne.  Traditional and Gentlemen's Afternoon Tea is priced at £25.95pp, with the option of upgrading to Champagne Afternoon Tea for just £9.00pp.  Park Plaza Cardiff is located in a buzzing area of the capital, near to Cardiff Castle and Cardiff University.
